1	/**
2	 * File-spool dispatch fallback — ant 5165.js XF3/EFK/fF3.
3	 *
4	 * Watches `~/.claude/daemon/dispatch/` for incoming dispatch envelope
5	 * files. Each file is one dispatch request that the CLI couldn't deliver
6	 * via socket (e.g. daemon mid-restart). Daemon picks up via fs.watch on
7	 * boot + every 5s rescan, validates schema/size/age, applies as if it
8	 * were a socket dispatch, deletes on success or moves to `rejected/` on
9	 * failure.
10	 *
11	 * Survives daemon restart between CLI write and daemon read — the file
12	 * just sits there until next daemon comes up. socket-only dispatch
13	 * loses any in-flight request when daemon dies mid-handle.
14	 *
15	 * ccb uses Node `fs.watch` instead of chokidar (one less dep). On macOS
16	 * fs.watch fires 'rename' events on file create AND delete — we filter
17	 * by lstat to distinguish, plus poll every 5s as backup since fs.watch
18	 * can miss events under load.
19	 *
20	 * @dynamicRequire
21	 */
22	
23	import {
24	  type FSWatcher,
25	  existsSync,
26	  lstatSync,
27	  mkdirSync,
28	  readdirSync,
29	  readFileSync,
30	  renameSync,
31	  unlinkSync,
32	  watch,
33	  writeFileSync,
34	} from 'node:fs'
35	import { basename, join } from 'node:path'
36	
37	import { getConfigHomeDir } from '@thyrox/config/env/configHome.js'
38	import { logEvent } from '@thyrox/local-observability'
39	
40	/** ant 5165.js DF3 — max age before a spool file is considered stale (24h). */
41	const MAX_AGE_MS = 86_400_000
42	/** ant 5165.js MF3 — max body size for a single dispatch envelope (256 KiB). */
43	const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 262_144
44	
45	export interface DispatchEnvelope {
46	  /** ms-epoch when CLI wrote this envelope. Daemon rejects if too old. */
47	  createdAt: number
48	  /** Daemon op to invoke once envelope is ingested. Same as socket op. */
49	  op: string
50	  /** Op payload (passed to handler as msg.d). */
51	  d: Record<string, unknown>
52	  /** Optional nonce for await-ack pairing. */
53	  nonce?: string
54	}
55	
56	function getSpoolDir(): string {
57	  return join(getConfigHomeDir(), 'daemon', 'dispatch')
58	}
59	
60	function getRejectedDir(): string {
61	  return join(getSpoolDir(), 'rejected')
62	}
63	
64	function isTempFile(name: string): boolean {
65	  return name.endsWith('.tmp') || name.includes('.tmp.')
66	}
67	
68	/**
69	 * ant 5165.js NrH — move a bad envelope to rejected/ subdir.
70	 */
71	function rejectFile(path: string, reason: string): void {
72	  try {
73	    mkdirSync(getRejectedDir(), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
74	    const dest = join(getRejectedDir(), basename(path))
75	    try { renameSync(path, dest) } catch { unlinkSync(path) }
76	  } catch {
77	    // best-effort — can't reject, just unlink
78	    try { unlinkSync(path) } catch { /**/ }
79	  }
80	  logEvent('tengu_bg_dispatch_rejected', { reason: reason.slice(0, 100) })
81	}
82	
83	/**
84	 * ant 5165.js EFK — process one envelope file. Returns `null` on success
85	 * (file consumed) or a rejection reason string. Sync because daemon
86	 * dispatch path is synchronous; the actual handler invocation is async
87	 * via the deliver callback which the caller awaits.
88	 */
89	export async function ingestEnvelope(
90	  path: string,
91	  deliver: (env: DispatchEnvelope) => Promise<void> | void,
92	): Promise<string | null> {
93	  let stat
94	  try {
95	    stat = lstatSync(path)
96	  } catch (e) {
97	    if ((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return null
98	    rejectFile(path, (e as Error).message)
99	    return 'read-failed'
100	  }
101	  if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) {
102	    rejectFile(path, 'symlink')
103	    return 'symlink'
104	  }
105	  if (stat.size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
106	    rejectFile(path, `oversized (${stat.size} bytes)`)
107	    return 'oversized'
108	  }
109	  let raw: string
110	  try {
111	    raw = readFileSync(path, 'utf8')
112	  } catch (e) {
113	    if ((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return null
114	    rejectFile(path, (e as Error).message)
115	    return 'read-failed'
116	  }
117	  let env: DispatchEnvelope
118	  try {
119	    env = JSON.parse(raw) as DispatchEnvelope
120	  } catch {
121	    rejectFile(path, 'bad-json')
122	    return 'bad-json'
123	  }
124	  if (!env || typeof env !== 'object' || typeof env.op !== 'string' || typeof env.createdAt !== 'number' || !env.d || typeof env.d !== 'object') {
125	    rejectFile(path, 'schema')
126	    return 'schema'
127	  }
128	  if (Date.now() - env.createdAt > MAX_AGE_MS) {
129	    rejectFile(path, 'stale')
130	    return 'stale'
131	  }
132	  try {
133	    await deliver(env)
134	  } catch (e) {
135	    rejectFile(path, `deliver-failed: ${(e as Error).message.slice(0, 60)}`)
136	    return 'deliver-failed'
137	  }
138	  try { unlinkSync(path) } catch { /**/ }
139	  return null
140	}
141	
142	/**
143	 * ant 5165.js fF3 — drain any pre-existing files in spool dir on boot.
144	 * Called by daemon startup before fs.watch is set up so any files
145	 * written between previous daemon shutdown and this boot get processed.
146	 */
147	export async function drainSpool(
148	  deliver: (env: DispatchEnvelope) => Promise<void> | void,
149	): Promise<void> {
150	  const dir = getSpoolDir()
151	  if (!existsSync(dir)) return
152	  let entries: string[]
153	  try {
154	    entries = readdirSync(dir)
155	  } catch (e) {
156	    if ((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return
157	    throw e
158	  }
159	  for (const name of entries) {
160	    if (name.startsWith('.') || isTempFile(name) || name === 'rejected') continue
161	    await ingestEnvelope(join(dir, name), deliver)
162	  }
163	}
164	
165	export interface SpoolWatcher {
166	  close(): void
167	}
168	
169	/**
170	 * ant 5165.js XF3 — start the file-watcher on the spool dir. Caller
171	 * provides `deliver` which routes the envelope through the same op
172	 * dispatch table the socket server uses.
173	 *
174	 * fs.watch is best-effort — a 5s polling timer covers cases where the
175	 * watcher misses the event (high system load, FS event coalescing).
176	 */
177	export function startSpoolWatcher(
178	  deliver: (env: DispatchEnvelope) => Promise<void> | void,
179	): SpoolWatcher {
180	  const dir = getSpoolDir()
181	  try {
182	    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
183	  } catch (e) {
184	    logEvent('tengu_bg_dispatch_watcher_failed', {
185	      errno: (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code ?? 'unknown',
186	      reason: 'mkdir',
187	    })
188	  }
189	  let watcher: FSWatcher | undefined
190	  try {
191	    watcher = watch(dir, { persistent: false }, (_event, filename) => {
192	      if (!filename) return
193	      const fname = String(filename)
194	      if (isTempFile(fname) || fname === 'rejected' || fname.startsWith('.')) return
195	      const path = join(dir, fname)
196	      // Only ingest on existence (i.e. add or rename-into); ENOENT means rename-out.
197	      if (!existsSync(path)) return
198	      void ingestEnvelope(path, deliver).catch(() => {})
199	    })
200	    watcher.on('error', e => {
201	      logEvent('tengu_bg_dispatch_watcher_failed', {
202	        errno: (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code ?? 'unknown',
203	      })
204	    })
205	  } catch (e) {
206	    logEvent('tengu_bg_dispatch_watcher_failed', {
207	      errno: (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code ?? 'unknown',
208	      reason: 'watch-setup',
209	    })
210	  }
211	  // 5s poll backup (ant doesn't have this — chokidar polls internally on macOS).
212	  const pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
213	    void drainSpool(deliver).catch(() => {})
214	  }, 5000)
215	  pollTimer.unref()
216	  return {
217	    close(): void {
218	      if (watcher) try { watcher.close() } catch { /**/ }
219	      clearInterval(pollTimer)
220	    },
221	  }
222	}
223	
224	/**
225	 * Write a dispatch envelope to the spool dir. Caller-side helper used
226	 * by CLI when daemon socket is unreachable.
227	 *
228	 * Atomic-write via tmp + rename (so the watcher never sees a partial
229	 * file). Returns the path to the spooled envelope.
230	 */
231	export function writeSpoolEnvelope(env: DispatchEnvelope): string {
232	  const dir = getSpoolDir()
233	  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
234	  const id = `${env.createdAt}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`
235	  const tmp = join(dir, `${id}.tmp`)
236	  const dest = join(dir, `${id}.json`)
237	  writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(env), { mode: 0o600 })
238	  renameSync(tmp, dest)
239	  return dest
240	}
